result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: a stale loading indicator over loaded content and awkward clipping in horizontal carousels.

issues.description: A loading spinner is displayed over the fully rendered Tokumaru Ramen Bar image, making the card appear stuck in a loading state.
issues.suggestion: Remove the spinner as soon as the image finishes loading, or keep the image hidden until loading is complete.

issues.description: Items at the right edge of the category and “Fastest near you” carousels are abruptly clipped, including a mostly empty category pill and truncated restaurant content.
issues.suggestion: Adjust carousel widths and right-side padding so the next item is either shown as a clear, intentional preview or kept outside the viewport.
